# Italo.dev

> Portfolio of Italo Saraiva Goncalves, a full-stack developer building production-ready web products, SaaS platforms, internal systems, API integrations, and workflow automation.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/): Professional overview, capabilities, and selected work.
- [Projects](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/projects.html): Case-study index grouped by product type.
- [CV](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/cv.html): Experience, education, skills, and downloadable resume.
- [Contact](https://portfolio-italo-dev.vercel.app/contact.html): Contact options and social profiles.

## Core skills

- Front end: JavaScript, React, Next.js, responsive UI, Bubble.io, FlutterFlow.
- Back end and data: PHP, Laravel, SQL, Supabase, database design, and authentication.
- Mobile: React Native, Expo, FlutterFlow, and iOS/Android delivery.
- Integrations: Stripe, Monday.com, Meta, LinkedIn, Twilio, Cloudinary, Outlook, WhatsApp, and LegiScan.
- AI and automation: AI agents, AI content generation, chatbots, n8n, Make, Power Automate, and Microsoft Teams.
- Product: SaaS architecture, internal tools, dashboards, document workflows, and web scraping.

## What I do

- Build production-ready web apps, SaaS platforms, and internal systems.
- Connect third-party APIs and automate operational workflows.
- Ship mobile products for iOS and Android.
- Apply AI-assisted development with human review and clear technical decisions.
